description: Bounded Vermont licensed-center cohort acquisition and immutable offline replay; not verified operating businesses.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and omit credentials. Fixed catalog/aggregate GET preflights and SODA3 query.json POST record requests; no method or endpoint fallback.
retry: No automatic retries or access workaround; denial or publisher deferral stops the attempt.
checkpoint: Persist prerequisite before roster requests and each validated observation before proceeding; reconcile baseline, selected rows, final roster and postflight.
idempotency: Immutable UUID acquisitions and independent offline replay. Reuse verified retained releases; partial journals are inspectable, not automatic restart or resume.
cancellation: Abort headers, body and pacing; drain retained writes, clean only owned incomplete cancellation artifacts and preserve uncertain publications.
retention_profile: Internal selected center-only records and sanitized metadata; omit contacts, person IDs, home-provider rows and jittered coordinates.
